# AppSec Atlas
> The World's Most Comprehensive Open-Source Application Security Knowledge Base

AppSec Atlas is a free, open-source security knowledge base covering the full spectrum of modern application security — from foundational principles to cutting-edge AI/ML security research.

- Website: https://www.appsecatlas.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/AnimeshShaw/AppSec-Atlas
- Discord: https://discord.gg/NHvrkJ5Hg3
- License: CC BY 4.0

## Guide Categories

### Foundational Security
- Getting Started: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/getting-started
- OWASP Top 10: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/owasp-top-10
- Cryptography & PKI: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/cryptography
- Authentication & Authorization: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/auth-and-authz
- Secure Coding Practices: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/secure-coding
- Security Design Patterns: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/security-design-patterns
- Zero Trust Architecture: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/foundational/zero-trust

### Web & API Security
- Web Application Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/web-application-security
- API Security (REST/GraphQL/gRPC): https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/api-security
- Frontend Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/frontend-security
- Mobile Security (iOS/Android): https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/mobile-security
- CORS & Same-Origin Policy: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/cors-and-sop
- GraphQL Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/graphql-security
- gRPC Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/web-and-api/grpc-security

### Cloud & Infrastructure Security
- Cloud Security (AWS/GCP/Azure): https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/cloud-and-infra/cloud-security

- Infrastructure as Code Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/cloud-and-infra/iac-security
- Serverless Security: https://www.appsecatlas.com/docs/cloud-and-infra/serverless-security
